create_custom_hook: create a custom ClassyHook subclass that implements on_start, on_step, and on_end lifecycle methods
store_hook_state: store serializable state data in self.state attributes of a ClassyHook subclass instance
checkpoint_hook_state: get and set ClassyHook state dictionaries for saving and restoring hook checkpoints
configure_hook_from_dict: instantiate a ClassyHook subclass from a config dictionary using the from_config class method
disable_hook_method: set a hook method to _noop to disable that specific lifecycle callback in a subclass
